name: seanmorris/sm-no-saccade-style
description: PHP-CS-Fixer style package for left-rail punctuation, Allman blocks, tabs, and tight control parens.

scripts.coverage: php -r "if (!extension_loaded('xdebug') && !extension_loaded('pcov')) { fwrite(STDERR, 'No PHP coverage driver available; skipping PHP coverage.' . PHP_EOL); exit(1); }" || exit 0; XDEBUG_MODE=coverage phpunit --coverage-clover build/logs/clover.xml --coverage-text
